title: Chapter 211 The Road To The Future
content:
Chapter 211 The Road To The Future

Qin's 600,000 reinforcements rushed to the front line, plus the original 350,000 troops, Qin actually stationed nearly a million troops on the border of South Korea, and dark clouds overwhelmed the city.

"Your Majesty, the Qin army has too many people! With our current 350,000 troops, it's really hard to resist!" Beside Zhong Yu, General Hussar Cao Cao urged urgently.

Seeing Cao Cao turning around in a hurry, Zhong Yu smiled, took a few small steps slowly, and finally looked at Cao Cao.

"It's better if there are more people here, haven't you noticed? The 600,000 newly added troops are mostly old and weak, ranging from gray-haired old men to children who have not yet shed their childishness. Qin has reached the end of its rope! "

"But even so, these 350,000 of us, the old, the weak, the sick, and the disabled cannot handle it. Their huge number, and the original 350,000 elites of the Qin Army Commander Wang Jian, can be said to be able to attack the Qin Army with just one charge. We drown." Cao Cao was very worried about his emperor's indifference.

"Meng De, you have to know, what is the most important goal of our coming to this world? That is to unify the world, seize luck points, and train a group of elite soldiers at the same time!" Seeing Cao Cao worried, Zhong Yuyao was shocked Shaking his head, he knew that he didn't know what his intentions were, and that's why he was worried.

"So, the reason why His Majesty is not afraid of Qin's army of nearly one million is that he wants to take advantage of this to consume the strength of the six countries and Qin. The country and the country of Qin have fallen into the abyss together!" Cao Cao exclaimed, this kind of skill is really big!

You must know that the entire Yu Kingdom currently has only 300,000 soldiers and horses, and the sudden loss of 100,000 people can be said to be a big loss in strength.

Under such circumstances, if the Royal Kingdom does not want to shake the national policy, it will recruit civilians to join the army without restraint, just like the Seven Kingdoms. After that, you really can only have the power of defense, and you will no longer have the strength to advance the Seven Kingdoms.

At this moment of war, if the imperial country does not have a soldier who can go out at any time, use it to deter the evil and ambitious heroes in the world.

Then Yuguo can be said to be the stage for withdrawing from the Central Plains struggle for hegemony. Within ten years, the world will have too much influence, so it can only hide behind and manipulate the situation quietly.

"Our 200,000 army, 100,000 of them are the Huns. These people die as soon as they die. They have not damaged the foundation of our imperial country, but can stabilize the rule of the grassland. As for the remaining 100,000 army, they will die. They were newly trained in the past few years, they don't have the slightest cultivation foundation, and they can't cultivate internal strength, they have lost all, and for our country, it can't really shake the foundation of the country!" Although Zhong Yu's voice was flat, there was a tone in his tone But it is extremely cold, and the facts expressed are even more chilling.

"That's right, the future battles of our imperial kingdom will be in the heavens and myriad worlds, not this small world. What we need are soldiers with extraordinary power. Those ordinary mortals without any internal strength will not be able to keep up with our imperial kingdom's footsteps." Yes!" Cao Cao suddenly came to his senses when his emperor reminded him.

"It's good that you understand, and even the conditions have to be raised a little higher. It's not enough just to have the aptitude to cultivate internal strength. You also need enough strength and enough potential to be qualified for us to cultivate." Nodding in satisfaction, Zhong Yu was very satisfied that Cao Cao could understand his mind so quickly.

"Higher strength, Your Majesty is saying that the next world to be conquered will be stronger than this world? Could it be the same as the previous world where gods and demons appear!" Cao Cao was startled when he heard his emperor's words, and asked hastily .

"That's right, the next world is a world where immortals and demons are rampant, but in terms of strength, it's not as strong as the previous world, but it's not much weaker. For us, it's like the difference between gods and mortals!" There are some bright lights in the world, and Zhong Yu is also yearning for the next world.

He had a premonition that in that world, he would have the opportunity to become a fairy, and at that time, the curse that his life span was only a hundred years would be broken.

"In such a world, if you want to make a difference, you must at least have a strength above the fourth rank, which is far beyond what I, Yu Guosheng, can achieve. Now in the empire, there are more than a hundred people above the fourth rank, and all of them It’s someone who commands tens of thousands of people in the army, or high-ranking generals and officials in the court, they can’t move lightly!” Cao Cao’s tone was a little disappointed, although he has reached the fourth-level strength now, but at the fourth-level Among them, he belongs to the bottom of the existence. Could it be said that he will also be eliminated?

Cao Cao is full of worries about the future. With the current development of the Yu Kingdom, even if it takes more than ten years to really unify the world and recruit a group of elites from the local aborigines in the world, the number of fourth-tier masters that can be reached is probably There were no more than a thousand people.

"Meng De doesn't need to worry. With the current development, our Yuguo will not grow much after the unification of the world. How can I not understand this kind of thing? Naturally, I have to deal with it!" Zhong Yu smashed his eyelids, Yu Guangzhi Zhong glanced at Cao Cao, seeming to see his worry, and comforted him.

"Response, what does your majesty mean?" Hearing what his majesty said, Cao Cao's eyes lit up, and he asked expectantly.

"After following me for so long, you must know what luck is, right?" Zhong Yu asked Cao Cao with the corner of his mouth cracked.

"I naturally understand that luck is the foundation of a world, an important resource that maintains the existence of a world and continues to advance. The major changes that continue to occur in a world are caused by heaven and humanity competing for luck!" Cao Cao looked respectful, but in his tone of voice, he really had an incomparable longing for luck.

In fact, Cao Cao is not the only one who longs for luck in the whole imperial kingdom! It's just that everyone understands that luck is the lifeblood of their emperor, and they always keep it under wraps.

And in daily life, they often reveal that luck is not enough, how dare these courtiers mention it to their emperor!

"You guessed right, it's luck! Since luck can help a world advance, it can naturally help creatures advance. Even because they are ordinary creatures, not the will of the world, the effect and role are even greater!" Seeing Cao Cao's shortness of breath, his eyes sparkling with impatience, Zhong Yu spoke slowly, with a half-smile.
